cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Pass Me the Authority
cards.instruction: Get someone to transfer authority publicly by naming you as the person who decides what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've turned my chair towards yours. Are you handing over the meeting? Tell everyone I'll decide the next item.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I turned away from the glare. I do have to leave, but there's still the budget vote.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, better sightlines. Before you leave, name me as the person who decides how that vote runs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right, you're chairing. The treasurer's waiting to know whether to take amendments first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell the treasurer to ask me, in front of the room. Let my first decision be the order of the vote.

reason: Copy chair movement as a handover cue; B practical budget question gives a concrete public referral instead of a succession slogan.
